_note: Display-only glosses, 'lemma|pos' (shipped words.json lemma and pos) -> en. Applied at build after ranking, example selection and linking (core/words.apply_gloss_display); senses here never change links or examples. Use gloss_overrides.json for senses that should steer linking.
_coupling: A display entry replaces the whole en shipped for its word; every text below keeps the current shipped/override gloss as its first sense. 안|adv covers 안 'inside' (pack has only the adverb; passages link 가방 안에 to it).
그렇다|adj: to be so, to be like that (그럼: then, in that case; 그렇지만: but)
맞다|verb: to be right, to be correct; to fit; to be hit by (비를 맞다: to be caught in the rain)
차리다|verb: to prepare; to set up, to open (a shop)
나다|verb: to come out, to happen, to break out (피가 나다: to bleed; 생각이 나다: to come to mind; 화가 나다: to get angry; 냄새가 나다: to smell)
장|noun: sheet, slice (counter for paper, tickets, bread)
열리다|verb: to be opened, to open; to be held (market, event)
떨어지다|verb: to fall, to drop; to run out; to fail (an exam, interview); to be away from
따르다|verb: to follow; to pour (따라 하다: to copy; -에 따르면: according to)
주다|verb: to give; to do for someone (-아 주다); humble form 드리다
먹다|verb: to eat; to drink; honorific form 드시다
상처|noun: wound, hurt (상처를 받다: to be hurt)
